comparison.objective: Select parts from a moving conveyor and assemble the pictured model while rejecting look-alikes; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Moving-object interception, visual discrimination, buffering, and ordered stacking versus fine tool use and response-driven adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct four-part model, all distractors discharged, no belt jam, and stable assembly; candidate requires two compliant stopping cycles.
comparison.reason: Conveyor selection and assembly-order planning test a separate ability.
